title: Inside Vistra’s 2026 Summer Internship Program

body_markdown:
Every summer, our interns bring fresh perspectives, new energy, and a willingness to jump in and contribute. 2026 was no exception.


Over the past several weeks, 113 interns representing universities across the U.S. gained hands-on experience across Vistra. From power generation, including 44 interns supporting our nuclear fleet, to retail and corporate teams, they tackled real work, brought fresh ideas, and made meaningful contributions along the way.
